data.body: **P2 — Unwind this context after later plugin scopes.** Invocation start and end hooks run in the same registration order. If a later plugin also attaches an OTel context, this token is reset while that newer scope is active; when the later plugin subsequently resets its token, it restores this already-ended Invocation span. Warm invocations can then inherit a stale trace. Dispatch invocation-end hooks in reverse order, or otherwise detach this scope after later plugin scopes, and add a two-plugin regression test covering both orders.
